newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH Q1 ELECTRICAL INDUSTRY EXPORTS UP 15 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH Q1 ELECTRICAL INDUSTRY EXPORTS UP 15 PCT.

text.p: Electronics and electrical industry exports in the first quarter rose 15 percent year-on-year to 10.42 billion markka, the electronics industry federation said in a statement on Monday.
Imports were unchanged at last year's level and the sector's trade surplus was two billion markka, it said.

"The biggest and fastest growing product group was telecommunications equipment, whose exports of a good 4.5 billion markka were almost a third bigger than in January-March 1996," it said in a statement.
